visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black-rimmed glasses and a black headband is shown in a close-up shot. He has a unique wig featuring black hair bundled on top, with long strands of red and white synthetic hair hanging down one side. He is wearing a bright red festive garment and is speaking directly to the camera with an animated expression. (2) The camera zooms out to reveal his full costume: a large, cylindrical red structure that mimics a traditional Chinese firecracker or red envelope. The costume has large gold characters, specifically '春' (Spring), and patterns embossed on it. He stands in an indoor hallway with a white wall and a dark brown door in the background. (3) The man reaches up and retrieves a small yellow prop from his hair area, mimicking the action of lighting a fuse on his head while making exaggerated facial expressions. He continues to speak rapidly, his body slightly swaying within the large cylindrical costume. (4) A red diamond-shaped graphic overlay appears in front of him containing the gold character '發' (prosperity) with a stylized yellow snake integrated into the design. He shakes his head vigorously, simulating an explosion of the firecracker costume, then settles back into a neutral standing position as the video ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male voice shouting a Lunar New Year greeting. An upbeat, fast-tempo electronic pop track with a synthesized beat starts immediately, maintaining a consistent rhythm throughout the phase. The vocal pitch is moderately high and enthusiastic. (2) The male speaker continues with rhythmic, rhyming blessings delivered at a rapid speech rate, almost like a comedic chant. The background music continues with a strong percussive pulse. The tone remains highly aroused and celebratory. (3) A distinct 'shhh' sibilant sound effect, mimicking a burning fuse, is introduced into the mix as the speaker pauses briefly. The BGM remains steady in the background. (4) The speaker makes explosive vocal sounds like 'ha!' and 'pshew!' to mimic the firecracker popping. This is followed by more high-arousal blessings and a final celebratory shout. The music reaches its climax and ends abruptly with the speech.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> List-based Blessings -> Skit Action -> Closing Wish
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic short-form skit designed to celebrate the Lunar New Year (Year of the Snake). The creator uses a high-energy performance, rhythmic chanting of blessings, and a creative DIY firecracker costume to entertain viewers and deliver festive wishes in a humorous manner.
